title: Limitations of Randomization Tests in Finite Samples
abstract: arXiv:2512.07099v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Randomization tests deliver exact finite-sample Type 1 error control when the null satisfies the randomization hypothesis. In practice, achieving these guarantees often requires stronger conditions than the null hypothesis of primary interest. For example, sign-change tests of mean zero require symmetry and need not control finite-sample size for non-symmetric mean-zero distributions. We investigate whether the mismatch between the null and the invariance conditions required for exactness reflects the use of particular transformations or a more fundamental limitation. We provide a simple necessary and sufficient condition for a null hypothesis to admit a randomization test. Applying this framework to one-sample problems, we characterize the nulls that admit randomization tests on finite supports and derive impossibility results on continuous supports. translated_title: 随机化检验在有限样本中的局限性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2512.07099v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：当零假设满足随机化假设时，随机化检验能在有限样本中提供精确的第一类错误控制。然而，在实践中，实现这些保证通常需要比主要感兴趣的零假设更强的条件。例如，均值为零的符号变化检验需要对称性，并且对于非对称的零均值分布，可能无法控制有限样本的规模。我们研究了零假设与精确性所需的恒定性条件之间的不匹配，是反映了特定变换的使用，还是更根本的限制。我们提供了一个简单且必要的充分条件，用于判断零假设是否允许随机化检验。将此框架应用于单样本问题，我们刻画了在有限支持集上允许随机化检验的零假设，并推导了在连续支持集上的不可能性结果。特别是，我们证明了几种常见的零假设，包括均值为零，不允许随机化检验。
tldr: 本文揭示了随机化检验在有限样本中实现精确控制所需的恒定性条件与常见零假设之间的根本性不匹配，并给出了零假设可接受随机化检验的充要条件，证明如均值为零等常见假设在连续支持集上不可行。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals a fundamental mismatch between the invariance conditions required for exact finite-sample randomization tests and common null hypotheses, provides a necessary and sufficient condition for a null to admit such tests, and proves impossibility results for continuous supports, including mean-zero hypotheses.
